site.name: Tuấn Anh
site.title: Fullstack Developer & AI Builder
site.tagline: Building useful software. Exploring AI. Automating the boring stuff.
site.bio: Software developer and technology enthusiast focused on fullstack development, AI engineering, and automation. I enjoy turning ideas into practical products, designing reliable systems, and exploring how AI can solve real-world problems.
site.longBio: I have a strong background in IT operations, database administration, and software development. My work spans the full software lifecycle, from data modeling and backend engineering to user interfaces, infrastructure, and deployment. Today, I am increasingly focused on AI engineering, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and intelligent automation. I believe the best technology is not just innovative; it is useful, reliable, and built to solve real problems.
site.availability: Open to interesting projects and technical collaborations
